app.title: Complete the diagram
app.brand: Complete the diagram · Scalable Systems Design
start.lede: Read the numbered requirements and put in each gap of the diagram the service that meets them. Every scenario exists in the four clouds with the same topology: pick one and compare.
start.empty: There are no scenarios for {cloud} yet.
status.idle: Drag a service onto a slot, or tap a service and then a slot.
status.idleList: Tap a gap and then a service in the tray.
status.selected: You picked {svc}. Now tap a slot.
status.target: Slot {n} picked. Now tap a service.
status.pickedUp: You lifted {svc} from slot {n}: tap another slot or the palette.
mode.title: Mode
mode.challengeNote: With a timer, no hints and one submit
bar.cloud: The same scenario on another cloud
list.title: Scenarios on {cloud}
palette.title: Services
panel.whyNotFallback: {svc}: {role}. It does not meet what this requirement asks for.
panel.nudge: Fix this slot and submit again, or ask to see the answers.
review.intro: This is the complete architecture. Walk through the steps to follow a purchase.
review.caption: Step {n}: {label}. {req}
say.reset: Slots cleared. You can undo for 5 seconds.
say.judged: That slot was already checked; ask for another attempt to change it.
say.budgetUsed: The suggested time is over; you can keep going.
say.sessionDone: You finished the scenarios for this cloud.
confirm.empty: {n} slots are empty and will count as wrong.
confirm.reset: The services go back to the palette. Solved slots stay.
notice.corrupt: The saved progress was damaged and was reset.
notice.newer: The saved progress is from a newer version; starting over.
notice.unavailable: This browser does not allow saving progress; it will be lost when you close the page.
footer.oci: Oracle publishes no SVG files: each figure of its draw.io library is converted to SVG with the same strokes and colours.
footer.disclaimer: Exercise for the Scalable Systems Design course (ITESO); not affiliated with or endorsed by AWS, Microsoft, Google or Oracle.
help.title: How to play
help.intro: Read the numbered requirements and put the right service in each slot. Drag a tile, or tap a tile and then a slot.
help.enter: Pick a service, place it in the focused slot or lift it
help.digits: Put the picked service in slot N
help.delete: Send the focused slot's service back to the palette
help.letters: In the palette, a letter jumps to the next service with that name.
